name: anim_player_weapon_event_firearm
about: The player's shot is the attack clip's 3031 event, dispatched from the player's own think, before the damage it causes. The player, a .38 in hand (player.armed, wielded by the ranged verb slot3), faces an idle neutral thug 120 cm ahead and holds +attack from 2 s to 5 s (a shot can miss: the to-hit roll is the weapon's). Retail's order (stories/v4/packets-R2.md extension 1): an animation event fires from the entity's OWN think, after its frame advance -- for the player CBasePlayer::PostThink 0x1016be10: slot 250 StudioFrameAdvance(0) -> 0x101600a0 -> slot 258 DispatchAnimEvents(interval, this) (the overlay body 0x10098c80: the base 0x10091880, then the layers through 0x10098cd0) -> slot 312 UpdateCharacter. The firearm's `*_attack_layer` clip plays in an overlay layer (smith_attack_layer authors 3031 at cycle 0: import/characters/character/shared/male/move_and_ranged.body.json), so its event is dispatched by the per-layer body 0x10098cd0 -> CBasePlayer::HandleAnimEvent 0x10178a10 (which passes the weapon band on) -> CBaseCombatCharacter::HandleAnimEvent 0x1032e330 (3000..0xfa2 -> Weapon_HandleAnimEvent) -> CWeaponRanged's operator 0x10238160 -> ModeDispatch(1) 0x102383b0 -> slot 373 Shot 0x102387b0. So: animevent 3031 on the player, THEN a damage on the target from the player.
notes: The target is an idle neutral TutorialThug (damage_lethal_death's row), so nothing but the player acts on it. A GUARD, green on the V4a seam's build: the 3031 and the damage are observed through the world-tick poll (H21); it must still pass once lanes A1 and A4 move the dispatch into the player's PostThink step.
